title: Holiday Tea at the Thomas Connor Nolan House in Joplin’s Murphysburg Historic District
seo_title: Holiday Tea at the Thomas Connor Nolan House, Joplin
description: This Victorian-style holiday tea at the restored Thomas Connor Nolan House (circa 1902) in Joplin's Murphysburg Historic District includes a personalized house tour, Christmas decorations, traditional English and Irish finger foods, and talks on tea etiquette and local history. It is for guests over the age of ten, and period costumes are welcome but not required. Two seatings are offered on Saturday, December 12, 2026, at 11:00 AM and 2:00 PM, on South Moffet Avenue in Joplin, MO; tickets are sold through Murphysburg.org, by email, or by phone.
